NOTE
**Still not ready — the fixture was written by hand, not captured from Jira**

New: The author changed the PR description to "Part of #16189" and added a screenshot. Missing: The description says the fixture was "constructed following Atlassian's specification", but Zulip's guidelines require a payload captured from a real Jira instance. There was also no new push, so the commit message was not changed, even though the author says it was.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have the author replace the fixture with a real captured payload, since Niloth-p has already rejected constructed fixtures on the related PR #39998.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description and adding the screenshot! The fixture still needs to be a real payload captured from a Jira instance (for example via webhook.site) rather than one built from the API spec; see the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines). Please also push the commit message update, since no new push has landed yet.
```
